title: Nha Trang in a day
summary: Start on the Trần Phú sand, eat the Ninh Hòa bowl if you can find it, and keep the afternoon for Po Nagar. The cable to Hòn Tre replaces the towers if the bay is the point of the day. Minutes between these stops were not printed.

stops.name: Nha Trang Beach
stops.note: The morning on the city sand. A beach ticket was not printed. Swim hours were not printed.

stops.name: Bún cá Ninh Hòa
stops.note: The provincial page says morning or evening. It does not name a Nha Trang street.

stops.name: Po Nagar
stops.note: About 2 km north. One page prints 06:00–17:30 and no ticket. Another prints 08:00–18:00 and 22,000 VND.

stops.name: Long Sơn Pagoda
stops.note: The seated white Buddha. The provincial page prints 07:00–17:30. No ticket on that page.

stops.name: Trần Phú night market
stops.note: After dark, behind 46 Trần Phú. The page prints no clock. Entry is free.

seoTitle: Nha Trang in a day — sand, then Po Nagar
seoDescription: One day in Nha Trang: Trần Phú in the morning, bún cá if you find it, Po Nagar in the afternoon, and the night market behind 46 Trần Phú.
